text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading back to the academy after an 
outing with Machikane Tannhauser—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait! Please don't leave just 
yet! Today isn't over yet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, since my Trainer is always 
taking care of me, I was thinking of 
treating them to something as a 
thank-you."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And so that we can entertain you 
properly, we even invited an advisor.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Here you go, then! Ta-daaa~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I am Ikuno Dictus. I will strive to 
meet your expectations, and look forward 
to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We're counting on you today, Professor 
Ikuno! Let's give Trainer the ultimate 
hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I have already drafted a plan 
for the "hospitality," so leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"We're here! This is where we'll show our 
'hospitality', right!?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But before that, there is one thing 
regarding "hospitality"—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What is "hospitality" in the first place? 
The answer I've arrived at is simply the 
act of 'attuning yourself to the other 
person's heart.'

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I see, I see~! And then, and then!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First, let's explore your preferences, 
Trainer. Could you do some shopping 
however you like?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, time to investigate Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I browse the shop window, feeling their 
gazes intensely focused entirely on me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how about that plushie over there? Big 
round eyes! Lots of legs! It's a perfect 
match for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That is correct, Tannhauser-san. Haste 
makes waste."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Professor Ikuno's hospitality lecture! 
Hold on a second, let me take notes!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*... Earlier, I mentioned that 
"hospitality" is an act of showing 
empathy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It isn't merely a matter of personal 
tastes and preferences. As a prerequisite, 
establishing a comfortable distance and 
pace is also vital.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So... does that mean I shouldn't force it 
on them?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Let us proceed while 
never forgetting compassion in our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~! As expected of Professor Ikuno! 
We'll be able to host them perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, there are so many key points to 
cover~ Just taking notes is a ton of 
work... Or maybe more like a six-ton of 
work?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure? Well then, I'm counting 
on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the lecture continued, as Machikane 
Tannhauser and I feverishly took notes 
together..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—And that should cover it. This concludes 
the intermediate level of 'Hospitality.'”

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hospitality sure is deep! My notes are 
totally packed full~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for helping me take 
notes. Now I can offer Trainer some proper 
"hospitality"—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to be treating you, 
Trainer, and yet here you are helping me 
out again...!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! I'm sorry! I got so caught up in 
the moment, I just couldn't help it...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I meant to give them some hospitality, but 
this ended up being total hostility~!
choice_data_list: Just make use of it going forward!
You don't have to push yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I'll be sure to remember 
everything I learned today!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let me give you a question, then. When 
providing hospitality, what must one never 
forget?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, errr... Making... making... making 
memories!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Close, but not quite! The correct answer 
is 'a compassionate heart'!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it really is so profound! I'm gonna 
study even harder!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser fired herself up for 
her next act of "hospitality."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to fuss over me, I'm okay! 
I'm not pushing myself too hard at all!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Saying 'don't push yourself too 
hard', does that mean 'it's better to just 
be yourself'?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! Just be natural, right! 
Naturally... Na-tu-ral-ly...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer... THANKYOUASALWAYS...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
HUH, IS SOMETHING WRONG!? WAS I ALWAYS 
LIKE THIS!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Machikane Tannhauser spent the 
rest of the day speaking rather 
awkwardly...
